samples.description: 1994–2000 U.S.-incorporated, nonfinancial/nonutility Compustat firm-years with an active primary CCM link and CRSP daily data in the trailing fiscal-year interval. Complete PTBI and temporary-BTD construction, positive current PTBI, no observed negative current tax under TXT-TXDI, stable adjacent-year currency, and no observed positive TLCF. Unknown current-tax and TLCF status is retained and flagged, not coded as zero. One selected final report per GVKEY/fiscal-year label; includes leads/lags needed for average-assets scaling.

assumptions: Equation (2) is one full-sample interacted OLS fit; SmallBTD is the reference group, with no industry controls, weights, or fixed effects.
Compustat legacy items #6/#16/#49/#50/#52/#170/#269/#270 map to AT/TXT/MII/TXDI/TLCF/PI/TXDFED/TXDFO, respectively, verified against cited provider pages and current catalog labels.

Current tax is computed as TXT-TXDI per the paper's Table 2 note. Only observed negative values are excluded; cases with missing formula inputs are retained and flagged as unknown under a stated best-effort screen policy. TXC is compared with the item formula as a field check.
UPD=3 is used as a provider-defined final-report status, not a paper-prescribed sample criterion; 5,526 UPD=1 and 535 UPD=2 rows are removed from 109,696 standard rows in fiscal labels 1993–2001.
Average total assets is not precisely timed in the paper. The build uses the mean of AT at t-1 and t for variables at t, and t plus t+1 for PTBI at t+1.
The paper does not give numeric SIC ranges; financial services are SIC 6000–6999 and utilities are SIC 4900–4999.
CRSP intersection uses time-valid CCM links with LINKPRIM P/C and LINKTYPE LC/LU, plus a CRSP daily record in the 12 months ending at DATADATE; exact author link rules are unreported.
The Compustat NOL identifier is unresolved. Observed positive TLCF is treated as an identified NOL; missing TLCF remains unclassified and is not set to zero.

Currency codes must be observed and stable across t-1, t, and t+1. Ratios remain in the reporting currency because numerator and denominator share units; changing-currency periods are excluded without conversion.
Scaled PTBI at t and t+1 and scaled temporary BTD use pooled 1st/99th percentile cutoffs from the eligible analysis sample. The paper does not specify pooled versus year-specific cutoffs.
The paper does not name a covariance correction. Stata conventional OLS standard errors and two-tailed p-values are used; an F-test compares the two PTBI interaction slopes.

limitations: The local current-vintage source build yields 37,521 CRSP-intersection firm-years before accounting screens, versus 47,507 reported in the paper; the final sample is 14,264 firm-years and 4,245 firms versus 14,106 and 4,048 reported. Source and local attrition differ across screens, and the mismatch is not attributed to a specific cause.

Local Table 3 Panel B estimates are close in direction and significance but differ in magnitude: interaction estimates are -0.108 and -0.228 (source -0.100 and -0.212); local adjusted R-squared is 0.262 (source 0.272), and local intercept is -0.0101 (t=-5.09) versus source -0.003 (t=-1.62). The local interaction-equality test is F=15.23, p=0.000095 (source F=15.01, p=0.0001). Published values were not used as filters or targets.

The local TLCF field is missing for 5,152 final observations, which are retained as unknown NOL status rather than set to zero. Observed positive TLCF is used as a best-effort NOL screen because the current catalog does not expose a separate verified NOL flag.

Exact average-assets timing, numeric SIC ranges, sample currency rules, and CRSP link selection are not fully specified in the paper. These are documented best-effort choices; changing-currency observations are excluded and the retained ratios are unitless.

The local provider data are a current catalog vintage; historical population coverage is not independently verified. The paper does not identify a covariance correction, so conventional OLS inference is used.
